0022600201.text: The Pelicans (4-5, 1-2 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) are 11th in the West and 3.5 games back in the Southwest as they visit the Clippers (1-7, 0-4 on the road, on a seven-game losing streak) for their 10th game of the season. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (out, knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery), Isaiah Jackson (out, groin soreness), Jordan Miller (out, shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (out, foot surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Pelicans won the most recent meeting 105-99 in New Orleans on March 19, 2026; this season's series has no games yet.
